ValidationRule.description: BOPI-727 This validation rule prevents users from defaulting the contract paper factor to 'Flywire' when the ship-to account is a Strategic Partner
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Strategic_Partner", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Healthcare", ISPICKVAL(Contract_Paper__c, "Flywire"), ISCHANGED(Probability) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update the contract paper to the corresponding partner
